blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved the merger of Century Properties Group Inc. (CPGI) and affordable housing unit PHirst Park Homes Inc. On Wednesday, CPGI said it will remain as the surviving corporation, while PHirst will cease to exist as a separate juridical entity once the merger takes effect. READ: […]...
